Searches names and contact selectors.

Storyboard

Bookmarks capture the full scene — node positions & layout, all active filters (clusters, tags, selectors, flow, connections), highlights (trace / lens), and the camera — with a caption. Present mode steps through them full-screen (arrow keys), and each scene is rendered into the PDF report.

Tags (click to filter)

Add tags to entities in their editor — e.g. mule, victim, SAR-filed, subject.

Buckets

Box-select nodes → “Bucket…” to collapse them into one container. Click a bucket to explore, expand, or copy its labels.

Money flow

Hides relationships below the amount or outside the dates. Click an entity → "Trace funds" to follow chains.

Connections

Show only entities with at least this many relationships in the case (2 hides everything with a single link, 3 keeps hubs, and so on). Applies as you type.

Shared selectors

Click one to highlight the entities that share it — address / email / phone / domain overlaps hidden in the base graph.

Clusters (click to toggle)

Shift+drag from a node draws a new link · Shift+drag empty space box-selects · Ctrl/Cmd-click adds to the selection.

⇧
Drop a CSV — or a saved CaseWeaver dashboard (.html) from any version
CSV: source, target, link, source_type, target_type · HTML: imports the embedded case
CSV format reference
source,target,link,source_type,target_type Jane Doe,Acme Holdings LLC,controls,person,company Acme Holdings LLC,PayVehicle Inc.,owns,company,company John Smith,PayVehicle Inc.,director,person,company Jane Doe,jane@acme.example,,person,email Jane Doe,"1 Main St, Anytown",,person,address
Relationship rows: source & target are two entities · link becomes the edge label · source_type/target_type set the entity type — person, company/org, infrastructure (host/server/system), account, malware, group, location, financial, event, document (blank = company).
Selector rows: set target_type to a contact field — address, email, phone, domain, id, ip, device, wallet, hash, url, user, mac — and the target value is attached to the source entity instead of becoming a node. Matching values across entities auto-flag as shared. Wrap values containing commas in "quotes". Repeated names merge into one node.
Optional: add source_cluster / target_cluster columns to group entities into coloured clusters, and amount / date columns on relationship rows for money-flow analysis (edge width, totals, timeline, tracing). Cyber selectors — ip, device, wallet, hash (MD5/SHA), url, user (handle), mac — make purely cyber cases first-class: shared values across entities auto-flag exactly like addresses and phones.
